title: Update a variable
summary: Kotlin: Update a variable. Add 4 instead.
introduction: var lets you assign a new value. += adds to the current number.

blocks.text: Install a JDK and Kotlin. Save lesson.kt, run kotlinc lesson.kt -include-runtime -d lesson.jar, then java -jar lesson.jar.

blocks.title: Update a variable

blocks.text: var allows the += line to replace 3 with 5.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: A variable keeps its type even when its value changes.
